Package dyntabs.ai.decision

Class DecisionEngine

java.lang.Object
dyntabs.ai.decision.DecisionEngine
public final class DecisionEngine extends Object
Bridges EasyAI to LangChain4J's DecisionModel — the counterpart of VoiceEngine for decisions rather than audio.

What a decision model is, and why it is not a chat call

Classifying, routing or gating used to mean a full chat completion with structured output: slow, chatty, and it hands you a word ("urgent") when what you needed was a number you can threshold. A decision model answers a fixed set of questions in one small call and returns probabilities. That changes the engineering: you keep the decision in Java, at a threshold you wrote down, with the measurement in your audit log.

It also costs a fraction of a chat turn, and several questions ride in one call — which is why the API lets you ask them together instead of once per question.

Providers

Only "openai" is built in. A decision model is a dedicated endpoint, not a chat completion: OpenAI serves it at POST {baseUrl}/decisions. OpenAI-compatible chat providers such as Groq or DeepSeek do not implement it and answer 404. See DecisionConfig for what to configure when your chat provider is not OpenAI. LangChain4j also ships Ollama (its local, key-free System One API) and TypeSafe in their own modules; they plug in here and nowhere else.

Analogy: a breathalyser rather than a conversation about whether someone seems drunk. It returns a reading; the legal limit is set elsewhere, by someone accountable for it.

      public static Decisions decide(String input, Map<String,dev.langchain4j.model.decision.request.Question> questions, DecisionConfig config)
      Ask one or more questions about the same input, in a single call.
      Parameters:
      input - the text being judged (a ticket, an email, a transcript, a diff)
      questions - the questions, keyed by the name you will read the answers back by
      config - which decision model to call and how to reach it
      Returns:
      the answers, wrapped so that absent probabilities cannot surprise you
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if input is blank or questions is empty
      IllegalStateException - if no API key is configured
